mentions.note: shared the pace with John Davies

photos.c: Dublin, July 24th 1957 and John Davies leads during "Billy Morton's Mile", followed by Cameron (A.A.A.), Hewson, Delaney (Eire) the Olympic 1,500m champion, and Pirie. A crowd of 28,000 was in attendance.

share.d: John Cameron in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1961–1976: 2 mentions in 2 issues, 1 race result and 1 photograph.
